req.statement: The system shall serve GET /health/ with sub-second latency and no external dependencies required.
triggers: health responds under load-balancer probe path

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /health/ returns HTTP 2xx with sub-second latency and no external dependencies. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — normal GET returns exactly 200; (2) negative NEG — wrong method POST returns 4xx (405); (3) boundary BVA — latency must be strictly < 1000 ms (testing the sub-second threshold); (4) DT — response body content is well-formed and does not require DB; (5) STC — repeated calls remain stable (idempotent probe behaviour). Each test asserts exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.executable:
import time
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_health_latency_sub_second():
    client = TestClient(app)
    start = time.monotonic()
    response = client.get("/health/")
    elapsed_ms = (time.monotonic() - start) * 1000
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert elapsed_ms < 1000, f"Latency {elapsed_ms:.1f}ms exceeded 1000ms threshold"

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_health_response_is_2xx_not_3xx_or_5xx():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get("/health/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.status_code != 201
    assert response.status_code != 204
    assert response.status_code != 500
    assert response.status_code != 404

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_health_repeated_calls_stable():
    client = TestClient(app)
    for i in range(3):
        response = client.get("/health/")
        assert response.status_code == 200, f"Call {i} returned {response.status_code}"

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_health_wrong_path_returns_404():
    client = TestClient(app, follow_redirects=False)
    response_wrong = client.get("/healthz")
    assert response_wrong.status_code == 404
    response_correct = client.get("/health/")
    assert response_correct.status_code == 200
